assertion.statement: The Hilbert class field of the actual imaginary quadratic K has Galois group Cl(K) under the arithmetic ideal Artin map, so its elements may be used in the subsequent finite Chebotarev choice.
assertion.objects: The actual imaginary quadratic K and the finite unramified abelian class field corresponding to all local unit subgroups.
assertion.hypotheses: K is the actual number field; the ordinary ideal class group is finite; finite-idelic quotient by K* and the completed maximal-order unit subgroup identifies with Cl(K).
assertion.quantifiers: Every class of the fixed ordinary ideal class group.
assertion.parameter_range: Conductor one; no order of nonmaximal conductor at this step.
assertion.uniformity: Qualitative finite extension and exact Artin identification.
assertion.constants: No bound on discriminant, class number or prime size.
assertion.normalizations: Arithmetic Frobenius of a prime ideal gives its ideal class; inverse convention may be changed consistently.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The existence of a prime representative outside exclusions is supplied separately by finite Chebotarev.
assertion.limit_order: Form the conductor-one class field, identify its ideal class Galois group, then apply finite Chebotarev.

use.reason: Supplies the class field in which the generator primes are chosen.

available_assertion.statement: Global reciprocity identifies finite abelian extensions with the appropriate finite-index open idelic subgroups containing principal ideles; the global Artin map restricts to local Artin maps, and units control unramifiedness. At unramified primes the positive prime ideal has arithmetic Frobenius.
available_assertion.objects: Number-field ideles, ray class groups, finite abelian extensions and local/global Artin maps.
available_assertion.hypotheses: Number field and the finite-index open subgroup/conductor conditions of the cited reciprocity and existence theorems; use the finite ideles for the imaginary quadratic specialization.
available_assertion.quantifiers: For every such subgroup and extension with the stated local conditions.
available_assertion.parameter_range: Finite abelian class-field extensions; arithmetic Frobenius at unramified finite places.
available_assertion.uniformity: Exact algebraic correspondences, with no effective bound or uniform analytic estimate.
available_assertion.normalizations: Positive prime ideal corresponds to arithmetic Frobenius; principal ideles are trivial.
available_assertion.exceptional_cases: This source statement alone does not identify noninvertible order ideals, prove CM-point reciprocity or construct modular parametrizations.
available_assertion.limit_order: Fix the subgroup and local unit conditions before taking its corresponding extension.
